changelog.change: Updated Input Safety
Added Hardcore Save Deleter
Prevent the safety loop from injecting global keyboard and mouse releases while the macro is waiting.
Verify that Subnautica is focused before every macro click or Escape input.
Add a one-second input safety loop that releases stuck keyboard and mouse inputs while the reset macro is active.
Immediately release macro inputs after completion, cancellation, errors, and component shutdown.
Replace loading-screen pixel checks with the in-game Press Any Button intro state.
Add LiveSplit-style keyboard hotkey capture and make the component logic-only.
Confirm main-menu buttons are ready in memory before starting a new game.
Support the Subnautica Speedrunning Mod Hardcore quit-button flow.
Update legacy RNG Mod presets to Subnautica Speedrunning Mod BetterRNG presets.
Add saved custom minimum and maximum explosion-time inputs.
Refresh the configured explosion range between reset attempts.
Use memory-based main-menu, loading, and in-game state detection.
Remove screen-color checks for menu and in-game synchronization.
Support explosion resets on the 2018, 2021, 2023, and 2025 Subnautica versions.
Read Aurora explosion time directly from game memory.
Improve explosion reset consistency, cancellation, and logging.
Add automatic Aurora explosion-time reset support and preset ranges.
Finalize and stabilize the Subnautica reset flow.
Add Subnautica speedrunning reset macros and configurable game-mode selection.
